newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends with smaller gains, bearish data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends with smaller gains, bearish data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market closed with smaller gains on late profit-taking and selling following a bearish official September crop report. Trading was volatile with some covering and buying seen in morning on higher Chicago soyoil futures.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Followed the futures market, with interest focused on products and nearby crude palm oil.

The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA), which announced the September data after the closure of the morning market, said Malaysia's crude palm oil production in September was 864,730 tonnes, up 6.04 percent from 815,446 tonnes in August, and compared with private crop forecaster Ivan Wong's estimate of 838,000 tonnes.
Morning prices were boosted by overnight gains in Chicago soyoil futures on talk China recently purchased or was seeking 200,000 tonnes of soyoil, traders said.
They said palm oil prices were adjusing to Monday's losses following the release of a bearish USDA crop production report.
"Stocks are expected to build-up in coming months in anticipation of higher output in October. Export business will remain small in near future," another trader said.
PORLA put palm oil stocks at end-September at 894,030 tonnes, up 11.33 percent from end-August, and September exports at 637,079 tonnes against 687,870 tonnes in August.
With the increased volatility, trading volume rose to 2,448 from 1,990 lots on Monday.
December futures closed at 1,139 ringgit ($454.87) a tonne, up six ringgit, after hitting a morning high of 1,148.
In refined palm oil market, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Nov/Dec at $497.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $502.50. Oct was traded at $497.50 and Nov at $495.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $537.50, Nov and Dec at $530, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $532.50. Oct was traded at $532.50, Nov at $527.50 and $525, and Dec at $522.50 and $527.50. Jan was dealt at $525.
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $380 and Nov at $385. Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $330.
